# Independent DAILY capacity producer

Source only. `produce.py` has not been executed and no expected output exists in
this stage. It consumes only the root-approved625fc3cb contract/input freeze,
the accompanying public source map/premise review and standard Python libraries.
It does not import Go, derive frames from product encoding or read stores/keys.

The producer emits compact ordered JSON plus one LF. Each recovery vector has
the complete ordered DailyReservation, its exact no-LF `reservation_json`, and
closed `accept`/`capacity`/`invalid` classification. Error reservations are all
zero. Diagnostic failed bounds are explanatory, not a new public error enum.
Envelope vectors contain the actual n+1 reserve, next failing ordinary candidate,
exhaustive predicate digest, binary-search trace and total probe count.

The oracle independently enumerates4096 ordinary candidates for each of six
fixed profiles and compares that result with initial-fit plus at most12 binary
probes. It computes the LCM once, verifies all original denominators and each
power-of-two binomial step, then uses frozen conservative widths for byte bounds.
Maximal grammar diagnostics deliberately retain the monetarily refused full
count tuple. They are not a successful reservation. Kernel membership/error
entries repeat contract requirements and do not claim session/owner execution.

Output also includes14 frozen recovery cases, six envelopes,14 selected-limit
refusals, nine malformed-input cases, configurable source/round exact and
one-byte-below edges, sampled one-axis monotonicity, fixed codec maxima, distinct
input-only320MiB and input-plus-change640MiB bounds, and conditional current-free-
byte holdback edges. Source/window/canonicality assumptions remain explicit.
No current work bytes or pending financial obligations are subtracted.

Root execution procedure:

1. Review this producer and the exact `producer-lock.proposed.json` inventory.
   Copy to a new approved lock and change only `approved_by` to `root`; preserve
   the proposal. The producer requires that execution approval separately from
   the earlier contract approval.
2. Run each existing Python3.14/3.9 interpreter with a fresh absolute output path:
   `PYTHON produce.py --lock /absolute/producer-lock.approved.json --output /absolute/fresh/reference.json`.
   Use a60-second outer bound and bounded log capture. No new dependencies.
3. Retain any failed attempt. Require both successful outputs byte-identical,
   <=2MiB each, input/source hashes unchanged and all producer assertions passed.
   Record interpreter versions and exact output length/SHA externally. The
   producer rechecks source inputs before writing, uses exclusive creation and
   prints only compact public output metadata; it does not create directories.

Dependencies are Python standard library `argparse`, `hashlib`, `json`, `math`
and `pathlib`. No local helper module or copied expected output is loaded.
The producer supports the two existing interpreter versions without requiring
Python3.10+ syntax. Its source checks do not execute the producer; execution and
output qualification remain root-owned.
